verdict.rationale: Google's support docs give step-by-step instructions for enrolling a Titan key with a Google Account, including platform notes such as a Linux udev rule and Android sign-in steps. There is no setup app, and guidance covers only Google accounts, even though the key works on other FIDO sites. Missing for 10: a dedicated setup app or wizard, walkthroughs for registering with non-Google accounts, fuller enrollment documentation beyond brief snippets, and independent hands-on corroboration that setup is clear.

support.subject: As a power user, first-time setup is guided — clear instructions or a setup app walk me through registering the key with my accounts

citations.quote: Enroll your security key. You might need to sign in.
Your device will detect that your account has a security key. Follow the steps to sign in using your key.
To set up a Titan Security Key on a computer running a Linux-based operating system, you may need to add a new udev rule.
